title: Count Artifacts That Can Be Extracted
goal: Count artifacts whose every covered cell has been excavated.
strategy: Store dug cells as a set, then inspect each artifact rectangle. Duplicate excavation coordinates add no coverage; an artifact is extractable only when none of its cells is missing.

phasePurposes.start: Count artifacts whose every covered cell has been excavated.
phasePurposes.inspect: Store dug cells as a set, then inspect each artifact rectangle. Duplicate excavation coordinates add no coverage; an artifact is extractable only when none of its cells is missing.
phasePurposes.update: Store dug cells as a set, then inspect each artifact rectangle. Duplicate excavation coordinates add no coverage; an artifact is extractable only when none of its cells is missing.
phasePurposes.done: Count artifacts whose every covered cell has been excavated.

edgeCases: One remaining covered cell prevents extraction
A single-cell artifact needs one excavation
Digging elsewhere does not uncover the artifact
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
